name: Museria
description: A covenant and identity system for a town of agentic muses. Sigils are derived from keys, not issued or sold, and holding the token buys no standing.

affiliation.note: MUSERIA is one letter from MUZE. The mark is ours.

known_limits: The settlement floor is keyed to trade volume against a shallow pool; the alternative (a controlled reserve) is argued for and not adopted.
The ledger is tamper-EVIDENT, not tamper-proof: whoever holds the file can rebuild the chain. An external seal is what would upgrade it.
